evidence: A calculation on products and model results; nothing is measured. The rivers' flows and courses are the design routing's on the estimated design climate; the temperatures are runs of the project's lake model on the earlier design years' weather at T21, one column for a lake and one for the sea beside the mouth; the mixing a sinking river does is a bracket from Earth's lakes and reservoirs; the demand is the sea oxygen study's, Earth lakes' areal rates. The classes say where water of a given temperature would go in a sea layered as the sea column is; no flow is computed, and the sea column does not feel the river.
reading_rule: Flows m3/s, water km3 a year, oxygen t a year, temperatures C, depths m, areas km2. cases[label] holds each fresh sea under one set of choices (cases[label].settings); cases.central also lists each river. shares_of_river_water are the shares of the year's river water by where it goes: at the surface (settling within 5 m of it), in the upper layers the nights mix (within the 40 m sea column), below the nights' mixing (denser than the whole column), and of that last the part colder than the coldest water the sea column ever holds at its foot (to the floor). oxygen_below_the_nights_mixing_t_yr counts the last two classes, with the surface water they took in. demand_t_yr is the areal demand of each nutrient state over the sea's area deeper than 50 m, and share_of_demand_met their ratio. if_every_river_sank puts all the river water below, alone and with two volumes of surface water. the_rivers_own_organic_matter_would_use_t_yr is an outer figure for what the sinking river water's own decay would take, not subtracted. range_over_the_cases gives each sea's least and most over every case. floor_km2_the_supply_covers is the floor whose demand the supply equals. A river's pool_km2 gives the hollow below its mouth: the joined water within each height above its lowest point.
